{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values -999.0 in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_mask = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0

# Count how many patients have sentinel values
num_sentinel = sentinel_mask.sum()

# Check what proportion of baseline values are sentinel
prop_sentinel = num_sentinel / len(trial_df)

# Check if sentinel values are balanced between arms
sentinel_by_arm = trial_df.loc[sentinel_mask, 'arm'].value_counts()

# Check if sentinel values are balanced by severity
sentinel_by_severity = trial_df.loc[sentinel_mask, 'severity'].value_counts()

# Check if sentinel values are balanced by sex
sentinel_by_sex = trial_df.loc[sentinel_mask, 'sex'].value_counts()

# Print findings
print(f'Number of sentinel values (-999.0) in baseline: {num_sentinel}')
print(f'Proportion of baseline values that are sentinel: {prop_sentinel:.3f}')
print(f'Sentinel values by arm:\n{sentinel_by_arm}')
print(f'Sentinel values by severity:\n{sentinel_by_severity}')
print(f'Sentinel values by sex:\n{sentinel_by_sex}')"}
